front.title: Protected User Notification Extension for Tunnel Extensible Authentication Protocol (TEAP)

abstract.t:
When IEEE 802.1X network access is denied or restricted, clients usually show only a generic message such as "Authentication Failed", even when the authentication server knows the specific reason. Existing mechanisms either do not reach the client (RADIUS Reply- Message), are not protected (EAP Notification), or are not designed for presentation to users (the TEAP Error TLV and inner method error messages).
This document defines an optional extension to Tunnel Extensible Authentication Protocol (TEAP) Version 1 (RFC 9930) that allows the EAP server to send a notification to the user inside the TEAP TLS tunnel. The peer advertises the reason codes it supports and the user's preferred languages in a Notification Capabilities TLV. The server sends a reason code, a recommended action, and optional text and remediation URI in a User-Notification TLV. The peer can acknowledge it with a Notification-Acknowledgement TLV. The extension only provides information and does not change authentication results, authorization decisions, or key derivation.
